objective: Propose the Jin Notes Wave-2 Track A (Folders) spec: real on-disk note subdirectories. Make fs::list_note_paths recursive; add folder helpers (list_note_folders/folder_path_of/write_note_in/validate_folder_path); migrate the index (SCHEMA_VERSION wave1-v1->wave2-v1 + folder_path column via guarded ALTER + re-armed version-gate rebuild); derive folder_path at rebuild via strip_prefix; thread folder_path through NoteRow/SELECTs/NoteDto + a SQL folder filter; add create_note(folder), fix edit_note folder-preservation, add move_note (link-integrity via ULID frontmatter), list_folders (index UNION on-disk scan for empty folders) + create_folder + FolderDto; the P0 export-sovereignty fix (recursive notes export + empty dirs + manifest subpaths + recursive s8 test); and a folder rail inside the Notes view (3-pane) driving NotesController.loadList({folder}) with router.ts/RouterController untouched. Obsidian editor (Track B) + folder rename/delete + CLI folder-awareness are out of scope.

context_delta.summary: Decision-ready dual-format Wave-2 Track-A (Folders) spec. 8 INVEST stories + 3 Kupo micro-tasks. Build order S1->S3->S4->S2(P0)->S5->S6->S7->S8. S1 recursive store + folder helpers (fs.rs:83-97,100-109; new list_note_folders/folder_path_of/write_note_in/validate_folder_path). S2 is the BLOCKING P0 export-sovereignty fix (export.rs:62-91,81 non-recursive read_dir + hardcoded notes/<file> manifest silently drops foldered notes; s8 tests at :205,:339-351 iterate non-recursively so they can't catch it) -> recursive notes export + relative subpaths + empty-dir preservation + recursive s8 fix + new foldered/empty round-trip. S3 schema migration (bump SCHEMA_VERSION wave1-v1->wave2-v1 schema.rs:8; add folder_path column CREATE schema.rs:19-29 + guarded ALTER mirroring excerpt at :127-131; re-arm version_gate_rebuild init.rs:53-75). S4 rebuild derives folder_path via strip_prefix (rebuild.rs:15,33-57) + NoteRow.folder_path + SELECTs (query.rs) + folder_counts + NoteDto.folder_path/with_folder (note.rs) + SQL exact-match folder filter on api::list_notes. S5 create_note(folder) + FIX edit_note folder-preserve (latent bug: title-change writes via fs::write_note which hardcodes root, relocating foldered notes) + move_note (write-new-remove-old, no frontmatter mutation; links survive because edges rebuild from frontmatter ULIDs rebuild.rs:162-229). S6 list_folders (folder_counts UNION fs::list_note_folders so EMPTY folders appear) + create_folder + FolderDto{path,name,note_count}. S7 Tauri bridge (move_note/list_folders/create_folder commands + folder args + lib.rs:25-63 registration + invoke.ts + dto.ts). S8 folder rail INSIDE the Notes section (3-pane: rail|list|detail) driving NotesController.loadList({folder}); router.ts ViewKind + RouterController UNTOUCHED (no 6th view). Anti-shallow load-bearing gates: VG-EXPORT (P0 round-trip), VG-MOVE (link-integrity post-move), VG-LIST-FILTER (create-in-folder->list), VG-FOLDERS-EMPTY, VG-FE (controller-driven Stimulus folder-rail). Frontend tests require Node>=20.

assumptions: The SQLite index is a fully derived, disposable artifact rebuilt from canonical markdown files (rebuild.rs:19-30).

Edges/backlinks are rebuilt from frontmatter ULIDs, never from path (rebuild.rs:162-229); folder_path is path-derived only and NoteFrontmatter has no folder field (model/note.rs:25-40) -> moves preserve links.
NoteRow.file_path (query.rs:18) is the real path written at rebuild (rebuild.rs:51) and api::get_note reads the body from it (api.rs:35); move must be followed by api::refresh.
find_note_path loops over list_note_paths (fs.rs:100-109) so recursing list_note_paths makes edit/delete/get(ops)/infer_kind work on foldered notes.
